author: Digital Foundry
description:
It's the Digital Foundry Supporter Program that makes the DF Retro Super Show possible! Support the team, support the show: https://patreon.com/digitalfoundry

History is repeating itself. Unreal Engine 5 is dominating the current-gen console generation, but it's not the first time that Epic tech has had a huge amount of influence - both Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3 had a huge amount of Unreal Engine 3-powered games. John is joined by Coury Carlson and Marc 'Try4ce' Duddleson to examine the wealth of games powered by UE3 during the seventh generation console era.

00:00 - Introduction
01:42 - What've we been playing?
18:06 - Main Topic: Unreal Engine 3 Overview
23:02 - Game Engines. What Are They?
37:26 - UE3: The Early Games
1:23:06 - UE3: Gears 3 and Beyond
title: DF Retro Super Show #007: How Unreal Engine 3 Dominated A Console Generation
